name: Hickory DNS Open-Source DNS Server
free_limit: Self-hosted Rust DNS server and resolver with DNSSEC and optional encrypted DNS transports; Apache-2.0/MIT software with no usage-based license quota.
watch_out: Operate your own DNS infrastructure, public IP/network, security updates and backups; no managed cloud DNS capacity or SLA is included. DNSSEC/DoH/DoT features depend on build and configuration.
